tour.fleet.0:
The Fleet page|Future prepares the fleet: ships, destination, mission. The game's Next and Send stay yours.
Let's set everything up in 5 steps.
tour.fleet.1: 1 · Fleet settings|Favourite Transport and Deploy targets, expeditions, the round of planets. Once is enough.
tour.fleet.2: 2 · Rules and fleetsave|For each planet and moon: where the fleetsave goes and what stays home. Until a target is set, Fleetsave stays dashed.
tour.fleet.3: 3 · Main ship|Tap this mark on the cargo ship you use most: Future works out how many are needed for the resources.
tour.fleet.4: 4 · Reserves|What never leaves this body: ships, resources, jump gate deuterium. A click turns each on or off; values are changed in Rules.
tour.fleet.5: 5 · Round|Repeat: after a send you move to the next body, to go round all of them. Skip this body: the round skips it.
tour.fleet.6: Mission|Transport and Deploy ask where; Expedition prepares the expedition; Fleetsave the escape; Last repeats the last fleet. The letter at the top is the key.
tour.fleet.7: Destination|To moon: everything to this planet's moon. Collect: brings the planets' resources to one body, by transport or deployment.
tour.fleet.8: Messages|Here Future says what it prepared or what is missing. Point at a button to read what it does.
tour.fleet.9: Next and Send|The game's button, within thumb's reach. Pressing it stays your choice.
tour.fleet.10:
Done|Next steps: fleetsave target in Rules, main ship, then try Expedition.
The ? beside each zone explains it again.
ptre.consent:
PTRE (ptre.chez.gg) is your team's database: spy reports, activity and players' planets, gathered by the team's members.
With the team key Future sends PTRE only what you choose with a click, as OGLight does: a spy report from the spy table (its API id only); a player's id and name when you open their PTRE info on the sheet; id and name of the players flagged PTRE when you sync the targets. Every call carries the team key, your universe and Future's version. Without a key nothing is sent. With «Send while playing» on, what is described below goes too.
The key stays in this browser and never goes into a backup.
ptre.keyHint: You find it on PTRE, on your team's page. Saving it, you accept the calls described above.
ptre.keyOnHint: On: «Save to PTRE» in the spy table, the PTRE button on players' sheets and the PTRE flag with the target sync.
ptre.keyBad: Not a team key: it must look like TM-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
ptre.removed: Team key removed: Future sends nothing more to PTRE.
ptre.saveFailed: PTRE did not save it: {message}. Click to try again.
ptre.playerHint: The player's activity and the team's best report, from PTRE
ptre.noActivity: PTRE has no activity for this period.
ptre.noBest: No team report on this player.
ptre.syncHint: Sends PTRE the players flagged PTRE and takes the team's targets
ptre.synced: The team has {n} targets on PTRE; {added} new here.
ptre.autoHint: Off until you turn it on. On, Future sends PTRE without a click for each call, as OGLight does: for every system you open in the galaxy, the planets and moons that are new, changed or gone (id, player, name, rank and status) and the activity of the players you follow (a flag, or opened lately); the counter-espionage you read in the inbox (who spied on you, from where, when); and when you open a player's sheet it asks PTRE for their planets, at most once an hour.
ptre.autoOff: Send while playing is off: only what you do with a click is sent.
